# Feature report: Acme Notes

*Sample report for the dashboard owner check. Made-up data.*

## Summary

Acme Notes is a shared note-taking app for small teams (E-002). It has two product areas,
**Editor** and **Admin** (`module-editor`, `module-admin`).

## Features

| Feature | What it does | How sure | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Export | PDF, Markdown and HTML | Seen | E-005 |
| Search | Full-text search across a workspace | Published | E-006 |
| Single sign-on | SAML, Business plan only | Published | E-007, E-003 |
| Share links | Public read-only links, maybe Slack previews | Educated guess | E-008 |
